approach: Repeat the complete 75-run V1 matrix with five independent seeds. Use the validated single-rank Release CPU binary, one OpenMP thread per process, eight concurrent processes, a 5400-second per-run timeout, total_time=2500, and a last-96-snapshot stationarity window with a two-standard-deviation reversal threshold.
runtime_basis: V1 observed 7.94 CPU-hours and a 1702.33-second maximum single-run time at total_time=1500. Linear duration scaling gives 13.23 CPU-hours, 1.65 wall-hours at parallel=8, and a 2837-second maximum estimate. The 5400-second per-run timeout leaves headroom for I/O variation.
evidence_boundary: V1B may validate numerical resolution and analysis premises for later Cycle 4 experiments. It cannot support the landscape-effect claim itself.
